raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the task by assuming it required finding when Omaha became the capital of Nebraska, then relating it incorrectly to Texas. The original task was to determine when the city the 2010 Sony Ericsson Open winner (Andy Roddick's city) became the capital of the state Beyonce Knowles is from (Texas). The mistake was misunderstanding the request which involved two separate states (Nebraska for Omaha and Texas for Knowles). There was no requirement or logical basis to link Omaha to being the capital of Texas in any historical context.
